name: Queue explorer
blurb: Move the arrival rate and watch latency go vertical before capacity runs out — with a simulation checking the formula.

inputs.label: Arrival rate
inputs.description: How much work shows up per second.

inputs.label: Service time
inputs.description: How long one request takes when nothing is queued. Capacity is 1000 ÷ this.

inputs.label: Simulation samples
inputs.description: More samples narrow the gap between the simulation and the formula. This is the input that makes the tool slow, which is why it runs in a worker.

inputs.label: Random seed
inputs.description: Fixed, so the same inputs always give the same simulation. A tool nobody can reproduce is a tool nobody can test.
